Description: Release kin_mat (7 kinematic variables x time). The paper estimated the movement profiles from the button/touch times with a beta-distribution velocity model at 100 Hz. StartTime 0 assumes the kinematics start with the neural export (lengths agree at 10:1 to within one sample); the release does not state the alignment.

position.Description: Position across all three dimensions (release description)

position_z.Description: Position in Z (axis between participant and touchscreen)
